tasks.title: Rename Board projection identifiers to Demand
tasks.objective: Board source files, imports, selectors, and persisted API identifiers consistently use Demand naming.
tasks.outcome: No Board-specific global-task module or task-named projection identifier remains.
acceptance: The Board projection module is named global-demand-board and exports Demand-only identifiers.
Desktop Board state, selectors, and workspace references use demand naming while preserving zero/multiple Session behavior.
A mutation of the Demand projection makes the targeted Board tests fail.
A production caller exists outside each renamed definition file.

verification.proves: Demand projection and workspace behavior remain connected.

tasks.title: Rename Demand control protocol and CLI
tasks.objective: Core control operations, receipts, parser names, and CLI use demand naming without task aliases.
tasks.outcome: The public Board control surface is demand.list/show/create/update/link-session/link-project/decision-log and agentmux demand.
acceptance: Core request and receipt types use demand operation literals, demandId, demand, and demands.
Desktop dispatch and CLI emit and consume demand operation names.
No Board-specific task.* operation or taskId alias remains in core or desktop control code.
A mutation of the control dispatch makes core control tests fail.

verification.proves: Demand control protocol and desktop dispatch are exercised.
Core and desktop Demand protocol compile.
